description: This file is an Astro configuration script written in JavaScript that sets up plugins, integrations, and build behavior for an Astro project. It includes plugin definitions, integration configurations for 'starlight' and 'tailwind', and a custom Vite plugin to remove '.md' extensions from URLs during build. The primary purpose of this file is to configure project build settings and integrations.

classes.name: VitePlugin
classes.description: A plugin object compatible with Vite that removes `.md` extensions from URLs during the build process.

methods.name: removeMdExtension
methods.description: A factory function that returns a Vite plugin object which removes `.md` extensions from URLs in files during the build process.
